facts: Official Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED API provides programmatic access to economic data and release metadata.
limitations: API availability alone does not prove that a preregistered commodity reference has the frozen frequency/timestamp semantics required by the grammar.

facts: Official U.S. EIA Open Data API exposes energy datasets and metadata.
limitations: Dataset-specific frequency and publication-time semantics must be proven before use as the commodity reference.

facts: Official CFTC historical Commitments of Traders reports are publicly available.
limitations: COT report reference dates and release dates are distinct; the historical-report page alone does not establish a commodity price reference at the frozen granularity.
